entries.title: Confirmed Seattle front absences prompt San Francisco revision
entries.question: Do final Friday absences and Bosa's confirmed return now outweigh Seattle's favorable opponent environment?
entries.why_it_matters: A previously tentative return premise is now contradicted; the comparison changes one slot and releases200 without forced spending.

interpretation: Revise Seattle toSF under new_evidence. Confirmed multiple front losses and Bosa's cleared return now outweigh the editor's retained matchup preference.

expectations.subject: San Francisco DST / Nick Bosa
expectations.statement: Bosa is expected to return to participation for the selected defense after Friday full practice and explicit coach clearance; a normal full snap load is not assumed.
expectations.support: Primary Friday report says FP and no game designation, with coach clearance. This removes one prior availability concern.
expectations.uncertainty: He has been sidelined since Week2; Sunday inactivity, a limited rotation and in-game setback remain possible. Other secondary players questionable.
expectations.challenge: Inactive status or restricted participation would challenge the return condition; active status alone does not establish pass-rush effectiveness.
expectations.observe: Official active list and participation/snaps if available; sacks/turnovers and opponent passing volume separately. Pressure data unassessable if not accessible.

expectations.subject: Adonai Mitchell
expectations.statement: Mitchell is retained for meaningful receiving involvement with Wilson ruled out, without assuming he inherits Wilson's entire workload or repeats142yards.
expectations.support: Retained Week8nine targets and currentofficialWilsonOUT establish a changed competition condition.
expectations.uncertainty: Passing volume, coverage and distribution among Mitchell/Cooper/Taylor/backs remain unknown.
expectations.challenge: Few opportunities while active despite team passing involvement elsewhere would challenge the retained role case.
expectations.observe: Targets, catches, team attempts and target distribution; distinguish low teamvolume from loss of individual involvement.
expectations.relationship: Changed supporting condition recorded prospectively; original statement andclock retained.
